evidence_identity.basis: Garay et al. CALPHAD 2009 Table 2 reports -46.9 kJ/mol-atom for SrSi in the first-principles GGA column. Li et al. 2011 Table 2 repeats -46.9 as GGA and cites Garay et al. J. Alloys Compd. 484 (2009) 822-831. That original Table 4 reports -46.89 in the GGA column, rounding to -46.9; the CALPHAD paper also cites that calculation paper as reference 29. The two retained reports refer to the same SrSi GGA result.

source_link_discrepancy.basis: Reference 17 in Li et al. names the J. Alloys Compd. calculation paper, but the current resolver links to the related CALPHAD assessment. Identity was verified against both source PDFs.

source_rounding.basis: Original Table 4 GGA column versus one-decimal reports in the two CALPHAD tables. The retained values are not replaced by the more precise primary-source value.

evidence_identity.basis: Li et al. 2011 Table 2 repeats the same compound-specific GGA/LDA values reported in Garay et al. CALPHAD 2009 Table 2; the method and phase match. Preserve both reports and count the earlier available reporting record once.
